reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 each data-name-1 of a CONTROL clause must name a data item defined outside the Report Section (file, working-storage or linkage), possibly qualified (OF/IN); a name defined only in the Report Section (report group, group entry, printable item, sum counter) is refused, and a name that is both is a nonunique reference unless qualified to the non-report item.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 picks the cited rule text of the nonunique-reference message (§1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SR3 vs §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1); the verdict is the same

reader.edition-search: Read the CONTROL operand loop of ResolveReports (LookupQualified, then IsReportSectionOnlyName -> ReportControlOperandShape COBOL1699, else ReportControlOperandUnresolved). The SR1 arm itself has no edition test; the following branches (Edition.SubscriptedClauseOperands, Edition.Edition.ControlOperandMayBeIndexDataItem) belong to SR3 and the index-item rule, not SR1.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the refusal of a report-section name and the admission of a qualified non-report name are one code path at every edition; only the cited rule in the ambiguity message differs.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover qualified file and working-storage controls and the unqualified WS/report homonym; not the refusal of a printable item, group entry, report group or sum counter, nor the qualified homonym legal form.
